mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sessions ( user_id, refresh_token_hash, device_name, ip_address, user_agent, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{deviceName}, CAST(#{ipAddress} AS INET), #{userAgent}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, refresh_token_hash AS refreshTokenHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, revoked_at AS revokedAt FROM user_sessions WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{refreshTokenHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oauth_exchange_codes ( code_hash, user_id, provider, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{codeHash}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, provider, expires_at AS expiresAt, consumed_at AS consumedAt FROM oauth_exchange_codes WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}
